The powder diffractometer instrument has been successfully rebuilt in McStas from the specification, validated, and executed.

### Instrument Architecture & Implementation Summary
- **Source**: `Source_Maxwell_3` thermal source focused toward the guide entrance.
- **Guide System**: Initial straight guide (`guide1`), curved bender (`guide2`), bunker guide (`bunker`), intermediate guide (`guide3`), and primary instrument guide (`guide4`).
- **Monochromator**: `Monochromator_2foc` placed on double-mosaicity/focusing arms (`sma` and `msa`), calculating take-off angle $2\theta_m$ (`TTM`) and Bragg angle $\theta_m$ (`OMA`) based on $\lambda = 2.5666\text{ \AA}$ and $Q = 1.8734\text{ \AA}^{-1}$.
- **Sample & Slits**: Collimation slits (`in_slit`, `out1_slit`, `Amoin_slit`, `Bmoin_slit`, `out2_slit`) leading to a `PowderN` sample (`Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz`).
- **Detectors & Monitors**: Position-sensitive and wavelength monitors along the beamline, ending with a curved 1D `Monitor_nD` banana detector spanning $19.9^\circ \le 2\theta \le 99.9^\circ$.
